scope: Research only. No AlReader check policy, URL, bundled binary or reader preference changed.

findings.finding: Both alreader.com and www.alreader.com return HTTP 200 with a short landing page and an APK link; no Windows release metadata or download links.
Former downloads.php?lang=ru returns HTTP 404. Direct historical ru/en ZIP checks timed out; their current availability and identity were not established.
The Chocolatey packaging repository uses version 2.5 and the same historical author-hosted English ZIP, rather than an independently maintained reader or download mirror.
PJCreation/AlreaderXPro is an Android APK localisation, with Smali and AndroidManifest.xml; it is not a Windows AlReader2 source fork.
LagranRn/ALReader is an unrelated Java reader.
00svd00/AlReaderXSync is an Android library synchronisation utility, not a Windows reading engine.
GitHub name search including forks returned 12 repositories; none established an active Windows AlReader2 fork. This is a bounded search result, not proof that none exists.
An indexed AlReaderX author forum header mentions Windows builds, but a direct current header read returned HTTP 403. No current Windows version or verified package was established.

recommendation_unapplied: Keep the bundled verified AlReader2 working. Treat its Windows version as bundled, with repair through the verified HomeLib Ru archive. Consider stopping independent AlReader author-site version polling until an authoritative Windows feed/package can be verified. Do not switch to Android localisation repositories or repack mirrors.
